findings.failure: Windows PowerShell 5.1 read the valid UTF-8 retry2 gate with its default ANSI encoding. The resulting mojibake in user_text made ConvertFrom-Json reject the gate before port enumeration/open.
findings.pnp_after: The target remains in normal composite USB mode with COM29 present; this is consistent with no mode change.
findings.classification: Host-side evidence-file decoding failure, not CDC/protocol/firmware failure and not an IO4 attempt. No device request or mode mutation occurred. The failed source summary and exit code 1 are retained.

interpretation: The failure is reproducible from the PowerShell 5.1 default decoding behavior shown in the embedded malformed JSON. The underlying gate file is valid UTF-8; this is distinct from the earlier console-output encoding misinterpretation.
